summary: The accepted baseline stopped on ReferenceError: PM_HOUSECAT is not defined while end.c:really_done() scored a live quantum cat. JS already preserved the source branch and species lookup but omitted the imported constant. Importing PM_HOUSECAT restores the completed escape output; the unchanged admitted recording now matches in full.

source.branch: really_done()'s ESCAPED/ASCENDED score block checks Schroedingers_cat, obtains adj_lev(&mons[PM_HOUSECAT]), rolls d(m_lev, 8), adds the hit points to u.urexp, and appends the cat to the displayed pet list.
callers: end.c:done calls really_done after the escape state is finalized
js/end.js:done reaches really_done for the corresponding ESCAPED ending
dependencies: Existing monsters.js PM_HOUSECAT species index and state.mons entry

evidence: The admitted baseline evaluation for v71 reports Replay error: PM_HOUSECAT is not defined. The manifest SHA is f91e637b94dd4224eece47941f88a7f3a3e2d50eb31793ceddf2949b3ff3e703 and the recording SHA is c7a431e75eaa7cccd5d13a9fdd2e4dbe32d88c6a4f250a70e16024b0bee6544f.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/end.c:1454-1468 checks Schroedingers_cat in really_done(), calls adj_lev(&mons[PM_HOUSECAT]), then d(m_lev, 8) and adds the result to u.urexp before displaying the pet. js/end.js already mirrors this branch at 1521-1525, but its monsters.js imports omitted PM_HOUSECAT, producing the exact ReferenceError.
The fix adds PM_HOUSECAT to the existing monsters.js imports used by end.js. scripts/end-really-done.test.mjs pins the C species lookup and JS import/use relationship.
Post-fix bounded replay run-yhpBgQ of the unchanged admitted recording matched all 718 screens, 3684 RNG calls and 718 cursor positions with no error.
